name: Outage alarm: every 10 minutes check the website, admin app, HQ and gym server answer; open a GitHub issue labelled outage (emails the owner) and close it when all answer again
WhatsApp sign-in code set-up: register MettleUp's WhatsApp number, show the number's and the login_code template's status and health, put the WhatsApp token into the panel Worker (hand-started)

Checks on every push: phone-test file lints, typecheck and unit tests (phone app in 3 time zones, admin panel, panel Worker, HQ), admin panel build, panel crawl on phone + computer, admin journeys with UAT pictures
Database checks on every push: every migration applied to a fresh local database, function lint, security check and feature tests, backup restore drill
Razorpay test-mode check against the real Razorpay API (pushes to main and hand-started runs only)
Make exercise demo clips and exercise pictures in the cloud (Blender) and publish the clips to the exercise-clips release (hand-started)
not a product feature: marketing tool that makes the final owner-ad voiceover files (hand-started, output is a 3-day build file, nothing in the product reads it)
iPhone app build on a simulator with first-screen pictures (paused by the owner on 5 Nov 2026: hand-started only, no signing, nothing published)
not a product feature: marketing tool that makes background-music options for the owner ads (hand-started, output is a 3-day build file)
not a product feature: marketing tool that renders the owner-ad videos and feed stills (hand-started, output is a 3-day build file)
Update the Play store listing: replace the store pictures in order, optionally the title and descriptions, from the committed files (hand-started, has a dry run)
Send a release to Google Play testing tracks: phone app and watch app, with the What's new notes; never production (started by the release run, or by hand as a dry run)
Phone conditions test: upgrade from the previous release, no internet, flaky link, app killed, Doze, exact alarm denied (hand-started, advisory, not part of the release gate)
Phone test on a cloud Android emulator (the release gate): build once, canary + affected parts + shards with fail-fast, report that every part ran
Cross-role journeys test: member app + admin app + live server on the run's own fresh gyms (orders, cancels, messages, check-in, import, brand colour); hand-started
Build and release the phone app and watch app on a version tag: phone gate, tests, signing with key rotation, release checks, in-place update proof, publish the GitHub Release, then the Play upload
Take the Play Store app pictures on a cloud phone (hand-started; uploads pictures only, not a test)
Robot crawl of a released app on real phones in Firebase Test Lab (advisory; stops green with nothing tested unless the two Test Lab secrets exist)
not a product feature: marketing tool that makes voice samples for picking the owner-ad voice (hand-started, output is a 3-day build file)
Record the watch app demo video for Google Play's foreground-service form, from the released watch app on a Wear OS emulator (hand-started)
Watch app build and checks on pushes that touch the watch: unit tests, rendered watch screens, same-signer and signing dry run, then watch UAT on an emulator (stays in front, dims, largest text)
WhatsApp probe: one test message (plain text and/or the login_code template) to the owner's own phone, to learn what Meta's block stops (hand-started)
